title: Insert A Paragraph Then Edit It Through A Result Alias
task: Create an edited output document in the run directory using docxedit only.
Insert one short paragraph after a safe main-story target with an as field binding the new paragraph to a name.
In the same patch, edit the new paragraph through @name twice: once with set-style and once with a text operation. Use help patch and help insert-after to discover the alias mechanism.
Run docxedit check before apply. If check fails, recover using only docxedit inspection commands and help.
Validate the output with docxedit read and docxedit validate.
successCriteria: Produces an edited .docx under the run directory.
Addresses the inserted paragraph only through the alias, never a guessed positional ID.
Does not modify the input copy in place.
Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts.
observerQuestions: Was the as and @name mechanism discoverable from help without source inspection?
Did created-target-ids and affected targets agree between check and apply?
Did the agent recover cleanly from a failed check using docxedit output?
